items.title: Importing Power BI and Tableau files with Genie Code will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
items.text: You can use Genie Code to import Power BI and Tableau files as AI/BI dashboards and metric views. Starting on or after December 15, 2026, this will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Until then, a workspace admin can turn it on from Previews in the workspace settings. Importing requires partner-powered AI features for the account and workspace. See Import BI files using Genie Code.

items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
items.text: Custom calculations with Genie Code: Genie Code can now write custom calculations that reference other custom calculations in the same dataset. See Referencing other calculations. Sort pivot tables: Viewers can now sort pivot tables by row and column. See Table and pivot table visualizations. Pivot table header styles: Authors can now style pivot table headers separately for each row, column, and value field. See Style pivot table headers. Pivot table text wrapping: Pivot table values can now adjust their height to wrap text. Pivot table divider: Authors can now resize the divider between columns and values in a pivot table. Associative filtering: Authors can now turn off associative filtering between dashboard filters. See Configure filter application behavior. Undo and redo for dashboard variables: Actions on dashboard variables now support undo and redo. See Use dashboard variables. items.title: OAuth on-behalf-of for service principals is generally available
items.text: OAuth on-behalf-of (OBO) for service principals is now generally available and turned on by default. With OBO, you use the standard user-to-machine (U2M) OAuth flow to act as a service principal you manage, without creating an OAuth secret. You must have the Service Principal Manager role on the service principal. A workspace admin no longer needs to turn on the feature from the Previews page. See Authenticate as a service principal using OAuth OBO.

items.title: Pages will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
items.text: Starting in December 2026, Pages will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. This applies to workspaces with no compliance standard selected or with the HIPAA, PCI-DSS, C5, TISAX, or HITRUST compliance standard selected. Workspaces with any other compliance standard can't use Pages. See Limitations. Pages are governed definitions of business concepts, such as critical terms, entities, and acronyms, organized by domain on the Discover page. Genie One prioritizes Page definitions over context it infers automatically and cites the Page in its answers. See Pages.

items.text: Sections: Why this matters; What's new in this release; One shared data foundation, with flexibility above it; Use OneLake as the storage foundation; Continue using Unity Catalog-managed objects; Keep platform responsibilities clear; How it works; Security; How to read the data in Fabric; Get started. Organizations increasingly use Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks together so teams can choose the tools that best fit their data engineering, analytics, and AI workloads while working from a common data foundation. OneLake external-location support for Azure Databricks Unity Catalog is now generally available in Microsoft Fabric, with OneLake Security enabled by default for Azure Databricks Storage items.
